FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS • G ross premium income declined by 10% over 2015 June to stand at Ksh 6.2b as we continued to pursue quality over quantity business. • I nvestment income and other income declined by 22% from Ksh 1.58b to Ksh 1.24b in June 2016 mainily because of decline in interest rates and a depressed securities market. • C laims incurred declined by 26% from Ksh 4.3b in June 2015 to Ksh 3.1b in June 2016 indicating improving quality of business. • O perating and other expenses remained flat at Ksh 2.3b. • Profit before tax increased by 48% to Ksh 399m. WAY FORWARD The Group continued to embark on its strategic plan of consolidating our business gains, improving efficiency and settling our regional businesses. Implementation of e-oxygen system has enhanced our operation and profitability of our medical business. The refreshed unified brand continues to grow awareness and enhance customer goodwill. For and on behalf of the Board J. Magomere, OGW (Chairman) T. Gitogo (Group CEO)
